claim: *Correct judgment without enforcement.* The system observed the dangerous condition and evaluated it correctly, but no enforcing mechanism acted on the verdict. The durable repair removed the unsafe capability rather than making the warning louder.
topology: Detected unsafe condition and correct verdict, visibly broken enforcement link, operation and loss; warning is a side branch.
required_terms: Durable repair: remove the unsafe capability; escalate ambiguous merges to a human.
bw_encoding: White ordinary nodes and groups; labels and boundaries carry roles without decorative tones.
redesign: Native nodes and routed edges preserve the original semantic structure, with print-sized labels and fewer decorative frames. Grayscale refinement: Detection/evaluation paired; warning and loss have consequential gray emphasis; existing broken enforcement path retained. Fidelity pass: Restored the missing large cross at absent enforcement; shifted explanatory prose aside so the cross, warning branch, and continuation remain distinct.
alt:
A vertical cascade. A dangerous auto-resolution fallback exists. A sensor detects it and a
    validator judges it unsafe — sensing and evaluation both work. But the link from that verdict to any
    binding consequence is severed; the only thing emitted at the break is a warning. So the operation
    proceeds anyway and content is lost. Evidence existed and the judgment was correct; no enforcement
    mechanism acted on the verdict. The durable repair removed the capability rather than making the warning
    louder.
